label: Week 31, 2026
recap:
This week saw a modest amount of AI policy activity, with 8 bill movements recorded, meaning these bills had status changes rather than passage, along with 1 federal document and 18 case updates. Activity was concentrated at the federal level, with the United States Congress accounting for 6 jurisdiction-level entries, while Massachusetts accounted for 2. One agency, the Health and Human Services Department, was named in connection with this week's activity.

Among the themes appearing in the data, criminal law was the most common, showing up 3 times, followed by elections with 2 mentions. Single mentions touched on children and minors, employment and hiring, government use, and health care. Three bills did not fall under any identified theme. Given the modest totals across bills, agencies, and jurisdictions, this was a quiet week overall for AI policy and litigation activity.
